summary: medical joins MERGEABLE_KINDS: a backup carries medical.db and the import merges it additively. A PubMed record (PMID, version) only the backup holds is copied with its class history; one both hold keeps this machine's row whole (a newer one in the backup is counted, never copied over it); ids the user named join this list; medical_files and medical_cited (this machine's own reads) stay behind. Every backup row is tested before the write lock; a failing row is skipped and counted. The Living sources note names the medical store x12, the R746 waiting note is gone, and a backup carrying the store carries the PubMed credit line.
